queries: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count::numeric) AS average_count, SUM(type_count)::numeric AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.trader_type, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / totals.total_count AS share, c.type_count::numeric - totals.average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.type_count::numeric > totals.average_count;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count::numeric) AS average_count, SUM(type_count)::numeric AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.trader_type, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / totals.total_count AS share, c.type_count::numeric - totals.average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.type_count::numeric > totals.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: The primary query counts matched transaction records per trader type, so a trader with multiple records contributes multiple times.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct traders who have a matched transaction record, so each trader contributes once.
